title: AtlasOps Supabase foundation
context: Extend AtlasOps with organizations, memberships, sites, services, maintenance windows, incidents, incident updates, shift handoffs, subscriptions, and audit events using migrations, synthetic seeds, validation, and row-level authorization.

stories.title: Model the minimum product data
stories.outcome: The schema supports one valuable workflow without speculative tables.
stories.context: Create the user journey, entity-relationship diagram, data dictionary, access matrix, and threat model before migrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Every table maps to a required entity in the user journey
Primary keys, foreign keys, required fields, timestamps, ownership, and deletion behavior are documented
Anonymous, owner, different-user, and privileged access expectations are explicit
stories.dataContract: ER diagram, data dictionary, and access matrix.

expectations.security: Authorization belongs in the model, not only UI.
expectations.privacy: Collect minimum fields and define retention.
expectations.accessibility: Field names map to understandable labels.
expectations.analytics: Product events do not duplicate sensitive row data.

definitionOfDone: Schema reviewed against workflow and threats

stories.title: Create reproducible schema and seed data
stories.outcome: Any developer can recreate a safe local database from versioned files.
stories.context: Initialize Supabase locally and represent schema, policies, and synthetic development data in Git.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase CLI initialization and migrations are committed
A database reset applies all migrations and synthetic seed data without dashboard-only steps
Constraints reject invalid relationships and required-field omissions
Environment documentation contains variable names and source only

expectations.security: No production dump or service-role value.

stories.title: Ship the first CRUD workflow
stories.outcome: The user can complete the selected create/read/update workflow with understandable feedback.
stories.context: Build one end-to-end workflow with server validation and intentional loading, empty, success, and failure states.
acceptanceCriteria: Create, read, and required update behavior match the accepted journey
Server validation rejects invalid values and UI preserves safe input
Database errors map to safe actionable messages
Owner and different-user behavior is integration tested
stories.dataContract: Validated form maps explicitly to schema fields.

expectations.privacy: Do not log submitted sensitive values.
expectations.analytics: Track successful workflow completion without values.

stories.title: Restrict the overly broad read policy
stories.outcome: One authenticated user cannot read another user's records.
stories.context: A seeded policy grants select to every authenticated user without checking ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: A cross-user test demonstrates the failure before remediation
Policy derives allowed rows from trusted identity and modeled ownership
Anonymous, owner, other-user, and privileged cases pass their expected outcomes

expectations.security: Fail closed and test direct database access.
expectations.accessibility: Unauthorized UI does not reveal resource existence unnecessarily.
expectations.analytics: Authorization failures use safe category only.

nonGoals: Hiding unauthorized rows only in UI
stories.seededBug: Create a training policy equivalent to USING (true) for authenticated select, verify exposure with synthetic users, then replace it.
